name: Lu Jui
bio: Lu Jui (陸叡; Lu Rui; 13th century) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 瑞鹤仙 (Rui he xian)
poems.author: Lu Jui
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
湿云黏雁影。
望征路愁迷，离绪难整。
千金买光景。
但疏钟催晓，乱鸦啼暝。
花暗省。
许多情、相逢梦境。
便行云、都不归来，也合寄将音信。
孤迥。
盟鸾心在，跨鹤程高，後期无准。
情丝待翦。
翻惹得，旧时恨。
怕天教何处，参差双燕，还染残朱剩粉。
对菱花、与说相思，看谁瘦损。
